spans.s:
m. (-ङ्खः)
The feathered part of an arrow.
E.
पुम् man, खन to destroy, aff. ड.

mn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गं)
A heap, a collection, a quantity.
E.
पुं man, and गम to go, aff. ड.

m. (-लः)
The soul.
E.
पुं man, and गल to pervade, aff. अच्; also read पुद्गल.

m. (-वः)
1 A bull.
2 A drug, commonly Māṣāni.
3 (In composition,) Excellent, pre-eminent.
E.
पुं male, and गौ a cow, aff. अच्.
